name: Meringata di Frutta in Coppa (Meringue with Fruit and Cream)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: Vanilla pastry cream, home-made or store-bought, as needed
Any fruit of choice or a mixture, as needed
Raspberry coulis or other topping of choice

steps: Spoon a few tbsp of vanilla cream into the bottom of a martini or parfait glass.
Cover the custard with your fruit of choice, leaving enough room for the topping.
Cover the fruit with crème chantilly, and sprinkle crumbled meringue chips on top.
Serve with a sprig of mint or basil and drizzle with raspberry coulis.
